records.title: JET: Justification Evaluation in Transformer
records.abstract_original: JET uses pretrained language and vision-language models to select among a finite set of answers without additional training. It evaluates candidate likelihoods directly and shares computation across candidates. Experiments on desktop CPUs and consumer GPUs assess decision accuracy and execution cost. Qwen3.6-35B-A3B achieves 87.48% accuracy on the full MMLU test set and 3.69 requests per second on a separately timed MMLU subset. The accuracy-throughput comparison covers model, hardware, and reasoning choices, with Jev as an external reference. Controlled execution experiments show 2.18-2.23-fold speedups from prefix reuse and cache management, and a 30.8% reduction in process time from input preparation optimizations, with unchanged outputs. Optional reasoning has a task-dependent accuracy-throughput trade-off. These results support local decision inference from existing models.
records.relationship_zh: 本地决策读出；Jev 对照
records.one_sentence_zh: 复用前缀计算候选概率；支持 VLM 演示，视觉能力未量化。
records.abstract_plain_zh: JET 让现有语言模型和视觉语言模型直接在有限候选答案里作选择，不需要额外训练。它计算每个候选答案的条件概率，并复用共同上下文，减少重复计算。作者在桌面 CPU 和消费级 GPU 上同时测准确率与运行成本。Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 在完整 MMLU 测试集取得 87.48%；另一个单独计时的 MMLU 子集达到每秒 3.69 次请求。比较涉及不同模型、硬件和是否开启推理，并以 Jev 为参照。受控实验中，前缀复用和缓存管理提速 2.18–2.23 倍，优化输入准备让进程总时间减少 30.8%，输出不变。额外推理的收益取决于任务，并会牺牲吞吐量。结果支持用现成模型在本地完成决策推理。

records.title: Do System One Decisions Add Up? A Study of Probabilistic Coherence
records.abstract_original: A decision model can give probabilities that sum to one for every question yet disagree with itself when the same decision is broken into smaller steps. We study this form of probabilistic coherence in Jev and the English Laya checkpoint, using 2,500 matched examples per system across TREC, CLINC150, and MASSIVE. Across 72,000 classification questions, we compare direct fine-label predictions with broad-category probabilities and predictions reconstructed through those categories. Both systems show substantial disagreement: mean category-level total variation ranges from 0.219 to 0.349 for Jev and from 0.424 to 0.689 for Laya, on a scale where zero means exact agreement. The consequences differ sharply. On CLINC150, reconstruction reduces Jev's accuracy by 22.9 percentage points (paired 95% bootstrap interval: [-24.9, -20.9]) and improves Laya's by 21.3 points ([18.0, 24.5]). The same directions hold across all three datasets, with all six unadjusted accuracy-change intervals excluding zero. Improved accuracy can also accompany less reliable confidence: on MASSIVE, Laya gains 9.2 accuracy points while its expected calibration error rises from 0.046 to 0.124. Error analysis identifies both broad-category mistakes and within-category confusions. These findings show why decision systems need joint evaluation of accuracy, confidence calibration, and probability coherence in the workflow used by an application.
records.comment: 20 pages, 4 figures. Code and experimental results: https://github.com/samanjoy2/system-one-coherence
records.short_title: Do System One Decisions Add Up?

records.abstract_plain_zh: 一个模型每次输出的概率虽然都加起来等于1，同一个决策换成分步骤提问，仍可能前后矛盾。作者在TREC、CLINC150、MASSIVE上，为Jev和英文Laya各测2500个匹配样本，共72000次分类；比较直接判断细类别，和先判断大类、再在类内判断重建的结果。两者都有明显概率不一致；类别概率差异均值Jev为0.219—0.349，Laya为0.424—0.689，0才表示完全一致。CLINC150上分步重建使Jev准确率下降22.9个百分点，却使Laya提高21.3点，三个数据集方向一致。准确率提升还可能伴随校准变差：MASSIVE上Laya提高9.2点，校准误差却从0.046增至0.124。错误涉及大类判断及类内混淆，实际工作流应同时评估三种性质。

records.title: Jev in Medicine: A Benchmark Evaluation. Preliminary Results
records.abstract_original: Jev is a non-generative "System One" model that assigns probabilities to predefined answer options and cannot answer outside them. Its accuracy and calibration on medical question-answering and case-based diagnostic-reasoning tasks are unknown. We evaluated Jev 1.13 on four medical benchmarks: MetaMedQA, PubMedQA, DiagnosisArena-MCQ and the NEJM Case Challenges. GPT-6 Sol, with (medium) and without reasoning, was the reference. The primary outcome was top-1 accuracy; key secondary outcomes were calibration, selective prediction and recognition of unanswerable questions. All 8,469 requests returned a valid answer. Jev's accuracy was similar to that of GPT-6 Sol with medium reasoning on PubMedQA (78.4% vs 78.2%;), lower on MetaMedQA (74.8% vs 82.7%) and much lower on DiagnosisArena-MCQ (59.8% vs 82.4%;) and the NEJM cases (61.8% vs 82.4%). On MetaMedQA, Jev's probabilities were the best calibrated (expected calibration error 0.063 vs 0.146), and its answers with a probability of at least 0.9 (52.9% of questions) were 93.4% accurate, but GPT-6 Sol was as accurate when it accepted a similar proportion of questions. On DiagnosisArena-MCQ, Jev's probabilities discriminated poorly (AUROC 0.645 vs 0.768). Of the 162 questions whose correct answer was "I don't know or cannot answer", Jev chose that option for 10.5% (GPT-6 Sol, 8.6%). Median latency was 0.27-0.31 s; all 2,823 items cost USD 0.08. Jev was fast and inexpensive, and its accuracy was similar to that of a frontier LLM on research abstracts but lower on examination questions and much lower on complex diagnostic cases. Task-specific validation is required before clinical use.
records.one_sentence_zh: 便宜快速、部分题型接近强模型，复杂诊断明显落后。
records.abstract_plain_zh: 作者用四个医学基准测 Jev 1.13，并以开启中等推理和不推理的 GPT-6 Sol 作参照，检查正确率、概率校准、只接受部分高信心答案，以及是否识别无法回答的问题。8,469 次请求都返回合法格式，但正确率差距随任务变化：PubMedQA 为 78.4% 对 78.2%，MetaMedQA 为 74.8% 对 82.7%，DiagnosisArena-MCQ 为 59.8% 对 82.4%，NEJM 病例为 61.8% 对 82.4%。MetaMedQA 上 Jev 校准误差更低，0.063 对 0.146；它有 52.9% 的题给出至少 0.9 概率，这部分准确率 93.4%，但 GPT-6 Sol 接受相似比例时同样准确。诊断题上，其概率区分对错较弱，AUROC 0.645 对 0.768。162 个正确答案为“不知道/不能回答”的题，Jev 仅 10.5% 选中该项，GPT-6 Sol 为 8.6%。Jev 中位延迟 0.27–0.31 秒，2,823 个题花费 0.08 美元。作者认为它适合快速廉价判断，但复杂诊断明显落后。

records.title: Decision Readouts for Text-Mediated Video Anomaly Detection: An Exploratory Evaluation of Jev and Qwen
records.abstract_original: How much does the decision readout matter when video-derived textual evidence is held fixed? We evaluate Jev typed decisions and three Qwen readouts on a sparse development sample of 40 videos and 400 target anchors from UCF-Crime and XD-Violence, each presented as a summary and ordered captions. Each dataset contributes 20 source groups and 200 anchors, including only 10 and 37 positives, respectively. The original five-backend pilot requested 4,000 predictions; Jev Choice returned 776 valid responses out of 800 under the study's strict numerical policy, blocking its full-coverage quality comparison. On XD captions, Jev Noul achieved 75.99% average precision versus 48.47% for Qwen generated probability and 57.81% for the stronger local ordinal-likelihood expectation. The latter paired difference was 18.18 percentage points (95% source-group bootstrap interval 5.53-31.50). UCF did not show a corresponding advantage: caption ROC-AUC was 52.26% for Noul and 65.95% for ordinal likelihood. Both probability readouts had higher, hence worse, UCF Brier scores than the evaluation-prevalence reference of 0.0475. We additionally audit historical LAVAD scores at exactly matched anchors and distinguish response structure from numerical consistency. A binary-likelihood control is missing. These exploratory offline results characterize ranking, probability quality and interface failures; they establish neither a causal typed-interface benefit nor general superiority, calibration or end-to-end acceleration.
records.one_sentence_zh: Jev 判断视频文字描述；不同数据集结论相反。
records.abstract_plain_zh: 作者先把视频转成文字描述，再比较 Jev 和 Qwen 如何把这些描述变成异常判断。研究使用小规模、分组的视频片段采样，并区分是非接口、选项接口和生成式评分。在 XD 数据集上，Jev 的是非接口平均精确率为 75.99，高于 Qwen 生成评分的 48.47 和序数读出的 57.81；但在 UCF 数据集上，Jev 的 AUC 为 52.26，低于 Qwen 的 65.95，而且概率误差不如简单的常数预测。部分接口还有无效输出。结果说明，同一份文字证据用不同方式读取，会明显改变表现；一个数据集上的优势不能当成稳定的视频异常检测能力。

records.title: When Does Selection Replace Extraction? A Pre-Registered Test of Agent Memory with a Typed Decision Model
records.abstract_original: Does conversational memory need LLM-extracted facts, or is selecting the right raw turns enough? Published results disagree. Extraction-based systems report gains from distilled facts. Recent studies find raw history with good ranking does as well, but disagree about whether ranking matters. We ran a pre-registered study on held-out LoCoMo conversations and LongMemEval. At a tight budget on LoCoMo, raw turns selected by a single call to Jev, a typed decision model, are non-inferior to an LLM-extraction memory (one-sided 95% bound -3.0 points against a -5-point margin). Blind human grading narrows the margin but does not change the result. Raw turns cost 3,061 times less to write, and the result holds with a second answer model. Within this study, reranking's gain shrinks as the budget grows. It adds 17.4 points on LoCoMo and 9.1 on LongMemEval when three of 30 candidates are kept. At generous budgets it adds 1.5 and 1.1, and extraction systems are more accurate. This suggests why published results disagree. At matched context, Jev selects as accurately as an LLM reranker (non-inferiority bound -2.0) at a third of the latency, and more accurately than a multi-call graph traversal. Reranking lowers correct abstention. Plans, code and graded answers are released.

records.abstract_plain_zh: 给智能体建立长期记忆，通常先让大模型把对话提炼成事实，成本不低。本文按预先登记的方案，比较直接让 Jev 从原始对话中选有用片段，能否替代先提炼再检索。在 LoCoMo 和 LongMem 留出任务的低记忆预算下，单次 Jev 选择达到预设“不明显差于事实提取”的标准，建立记忆的费用低约 3,061 倍；盲人工检查和第二个回答模型支持同一结论。只保留 30 个候选中的 3 个时收益较大，预算放宽后收益缩小，提取方法可能更好。对齐最终上下文后，Jev 也达到与大模型重排序比较的非劣标准，延迟约为三分之一。不过选择与排序也会减少本来应该拒答的情况。

records.title: RoboICL: Embodied In-Context Learning with GPT-6 Astra
records.abstract_original: General-purpose vision-language models offer a promising way to zero-shot robot control: \gptastra{} excels at open-ended and language- or image-conditioned manipulation but remains substantially weaker on high-precision and long-horizon tasks. We introduce \emph{RoboICL}, an in-context robot-control framework that narrows these gaps without robot-specific parameter updates or a learned VLA. RoboICL separates \emph{demonstration context}, which provides recorded examples when available, from \emph{interaction memory}, which accumulates the model's own actions and observed outcomes. Both use a shared observation--action--receipt--observation grammar. To preserve experience across task stages, RoboICL combines sampled demonstration blocks with bounded anchored memory. Fixed anchors keep earlier rollout interactions available for in-context learning, while the latest interaction supports immediate error correction. Across 30 RoboDojo tasks, using zero shot for Open and one demonstration elsewhere, RoboICL improves on official zero-shot \gptastra{} by 20--27 progress-score points in every category. It leads the leaderboard baselines on Memory and Open, achieves comparable performance to the strongest Precision baseline, and remains competitive on Long-Horizon. Its 30-task Overall score is 50.64, versus 33.68 for the strongest baseline. On a separate ten-task subset, RoboICL scores 60.60, within 2.00 points of the $π_{0.5}$ + \gptastra{} hybrid approach. On three real-robot tasks, mean progress rises from 14.45 at zero shot to 63.33 at one shot and 78.89 at three shots. On two development tasks, optional Jev-gated action reuse reduces \gptastra{} calls by 33--48\%. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/Mosi-AI/RoboICL}{https://github.com/Mosi-AI/RoboICL}.
records.one_sentence_zh: VLM 上下文学习为主；Jev 只在两个开发任务减少调用。
records.abstract_plain_zh: RoboICL 研究能否让现成视觉语言模型观看少量演示、保留自己的动作经历，就学会完成机器人任务，而不专门训练视觉语言动作模型。它把观察、动作和执行反馈组织成上下文，并保留固定参考与近期经历。在 30 项 RoboDojo-Open 任务中，相比比较系统，平均任务进度为 50.64 对 33.68；另一个十任务子集达到 60.60，接近混合控制系统。真实机器人三个任务中，从零个示例增加到一个、三个示例，平均进度从 14.45% 到 63.33%、78.89%。论文还探索让 Jev 决定何时需要再次调用昂贵模型，在两个开发任务上减少 33%—48% 调用。
records.limitations_zh: 主要贡献和大部分结果属于 VLM 上下文学习；Jev 只是两个开发任务中的附加实验，不能把整体机器人提升归功于 Jev。

records.title: SeLMRoute: Probabilistic Semantic Evidence for Large Language Model Routing
records.abstract_original: Large language model (LLM) routing aims to select the most suitable model for each incoming query. Most existing routers learn this decision directly from query embeddings, model representations, preference data, or clusters of similar examples. Such approaches can be effective, yet the representation used for routing rarely states what a query actually requires. We introduce SeLMRoute, a routing framework that separates the extraction of candidate-independent semantic evidence from the learning of candidate performance and the application of deployment objectives. A decision model first evaluates a set of interpretable questions about the query, such as its reasoning requirements and use of external knowledge, with each judgment retained as a probability distribution. The resulting probabilistic semantic state is used by a lightweight supervised router to estimate candidate model performance. Routing objectives are applied after performance estimation, which allows the same semantic state to support performance-oriented and cost-aware decisions. On the LLMRouterBench (15 datasets, 20 candidate models, 11,481 queries), SeLMRoute achieves an average accuracy of $72.08\% \pm 0.45$, while grouped five-fold out-of-fold evaluation reaches $72.64\%$, compared with $69.23\%$ for the strongest fixed candidate. The representation achieves the highest mean performance among the evaluated semantic, dense, lexical, and domain-level representations. In a separate 13-model performance-cost setting, SeLMRoute improves performance in all five grouped splits, with a mean PerfGain of $2.66\%$. Our code is available at https://github.com/Indigma-Innovations/SeLMRoute.
records.one_sentence_zh: Jev 提取概率语义，再监督预测各候选模型表现。
records.abstract_plain_zh: LLM 路由要为每个问题挑最合适的模型。很多已有路由器直接从问题嵌入、模型表示、偏好数据或相似样本分组学习选择，但这些表示往往不明说问题到底需要什么能力。SeLMRoute 把三个步骤分开：先提取不依赖候选模型的语义证据，再学习候选模型表现，最后应用部署时的效果或成本目标。决策模型先回答一组可解释的问题，例如任务需要怎样的推理、是否依赖外部知识，并为每个判断保留完整概率分布；轻量监督路由器再据此估计每个候选模型的表现。目标在性能估计后施加，因此同一个概率语义状态可用于追求准确率或兼顾成本的路由。在 LLMRouterBench 的十五个数据集、二十个候选模型和 11,481 个问题上，平均准确率为 72.08%±0.45，分组五折 OOF 为 72.64%，最强固定候选为 69.23%。在所比较的语义、密集、词汇和领域级表示中，这种表示的平均表现最高。另一项十三模型的性能—成本设置中，五个分组划分都提高表现，平均 PerfGain 为 2.66%。作者给出代码链接。
records.limitations_zh: 这是用 Jev/Laya 先提取需求概率，再训练下游路由器；不是仅凭 Jev 零样本直接选模型。论文代码链接 `https://github.com/Indigma-Innovations/SeLMRoute` 本次 web 访问为 404，不能保证仓库目前公开可用。论文正文的 JEV-Direct 单独对照得 68.78%；与它同一原始划分上的 SeLMRoute 为 72.57%，不要把这个成对差异与另一表的 72.64% 混算。

records.title: JEV as a Judge for Agent Trace Security: An Empirical Comparison with Generative LLM Judges
records.abstract_original: Security evaluation of tool-using agents requires judging actions in context, yet generative judges add latency, explanation overhead, and output-validation failures. We study whether JEV, a typed decision model, offers a useful alternative for retrospective trace classification. We evaluate JEV and four generative judges on four benchmark collections totaling 5,219 trajectories, using a common risk rubric and behavior-level labels. JEV attains a benchmark-averaged positive-class F1 of 77.8, compared with 74.1 for the strongest generative configuration, GLM-5.2, with valid-result coverage of 95.5\% and 94.4\%, respectively. Performance varies across datasets, with JEV leading on ATBench500 and MCPHunt and GLM leading on R-Judge and TraceSafe. Across the four benchmarks, JEV's median successful-call latency is 0.99 seconds; estimated token cost averages \$0.000195 per valid judgment. These results support JEV as an economical screening signal, with trade-offs in precision and recall.
records.short_title: JEV as a Judge for Agent Trace Security
records.one_sentence_zh: 便宜地事后筛查危险轨迹，不等于在线阻断效果。
records.abstract_plain_zh: 判断一个会使用工具的Agent是否做了危险事情，必须结合整个操作过程。普通LLM裁判较慢，还要生成解释、处理格式问题。作者用统一风险标准，比较Jev和四个生成式裁判，覆盖四组基准共5219条轨迹。Jev的四基准平均危险类F1为77.8，最强生成式配置GLM-5.2为74.1；有效返回覆盖率分别95.5%和94.4%。Jev在ATBench500、MCPHunt领先，GLM在R-Judge、TraceSafe领先。Jev成功调用延迟中位数0.99秒，每个有效判断估算费用0.000195美元。因此它适合便宜快速地初筛，但漏报和误报仍需权衡。
records.limitations_zh: 事后分类，不是在线阻断/真实防御成效。F1是各基准不加权平均，并先在各模型有效返回项上计算；有公共有效子集补充分析。两个数据集使用作者修订的行为标签。延迟不计失败、重试等待和修复调用；详细提示、输出要求、服务条件并不完全相同。没有训练投毒/后门实验。

records.title: JevVibe: Efficient Classification-Guided Secure Code Generation
records.abstract_original: Large language models can generate functionally correct code that still contains security weaknesses, motivating repair pipelines that first diagnose a weakness type before deciding how to fix it. The Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) provides a standardized vocabulary for such diagnoses, but asking an autoregressive language model to generate a CWE label and extracting it from the response raises questions about output validity, speed, and cost, as well as accuracy. We evaluate Jev, a decision model that instead selects directly from a declared set of candidates and returns a probability for each, against six open-weight autoregressive models and a frontier proprietary model, GPT-5.6-Sol, on a controlled 50-way CWE classification task over 1,916 CyberSecEval benchmark examples. Jev outperforms all six open-weight baselines on every classification and ranking metric, while its comparison with GPT-5.6-Sol depends on the metric: GPT-5.6-Sol achieves higher Top-1 accuracy and Macro-F1, whereas Jev achieves higher Top-3 and Top-5 accuracy and a nearly identical MRR, at $6.27\times$ lower median API latency and $55.9\times$ lower estimated API cost. We further build JevVibe, a diagnosis-guided repair agent that uses predicted CWE labels to repair code generated by Qwen2.5-Coder-32B-Instruct. With Jev providing the diagnosis, the agent increases the detector-measured security pass rate from 63.5% before repair to 70.7%, compared with 66.1% for LLM-guided repair. These results show that JevVibe is effective at improving the security of generated code, with Jev providing reliable and efficient CWE classification.
records.one_sentence_zh: Jev 诊断漏洞类别来指导修复；检测通过不等于证明代码安全。
records.abstract_plain_zh: 模型写出的代码即使功能正常，也可能有漏洞。作者先让模型判断属于哪类CWE安全弱点，再用这个诊断指导修复。在CyberSecEval的1916个例子、50类CWE上，Jev各项分类与排序指标都超过六个开放权重模型。相比GPT-5.6-Sol，Jev第一名准确率和Macro-F1更低，前三/前五命中率更高、MRR接近，同时API延迟中位数低6.27倍、估计成本低55.9倍。其JevVibe修复Agent处理Qwen2.5-Coder-32B生成代码时，检测器判定的安全通过率由63.5%提高到70.7%，普通LLM诊断指导修复为66.1%。说明Jev可以作为快速、便宜的漏洞分类环节。
records.limitations_zh: 单一基准、单一修复模型、单一外部检测器；检测器通过不等于人工验证安全，也没由这些结果证明功能保持。两类修复都会偶尔引入新漏洞，各语言收益不一致。论文不建立Jev的一般概率校准。没有训练投毒/后门实验。

records.title: NavJev: Efficient Vision-Language Navigation via Action-Centric Visual Compression and Discriminative Action-Semantic Memory
records.abstract_original: Recent zero-shot Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) methods increasingly rely on multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to reason over visual observations, navigation instructions, and candidate actions. Although effective, repeatedly invoking autoregressive multimodal reasoning at every navigation step introduces substantial inference latency, limiting the responsiveness of embodied agents. We propose NavJev, an efficient VLN framework that reformulates online navigation from repeated multimodal generation into compact visual compression followed by lightweight typed action selection. Specifically, Action-Centric Visual Compression (ACVC) integrates waypoint geometry, BLIP captions, and RAM semantic tags into compact representations of candidate actions, while Discriminative Action-Semantic Memory (DASM) filters shared semantics and maintains discriminative action-specific evidence across navigation steps. Based on these representations, Jev directly performs structured probabilistic decisions over the available action set. Experiments on R2R-CE show that NavJev achieves 27.0% SR and 22.4% SPL with only 0.65 s per navigation step, while substantially reducing inference latency and cost compared with MLLM-based VLN methods. The project page is available at https://kai-sheng-caesar.github.io/NavJev/.
records.one_sentence_zh: 视觉压缩与记忆生成动作证据，Jev 据此选动作。
records.abstract_plain_zh: 零样本视觉语言导航越来越依赖多模态大模型，把视觉观察、导航指令和候选动作一起推理。但每走一步都调用自回归多模态推理，延迟很高。NavJev 将每一步改成“压缩视觉信息，再做轻量候选动作选择”。它的 ACVC 模块把路点几何、BLIP 生成的图像描述和 RAM 语义标签合成紧凑的候选动作表示；DASM 记忆模块过滤各动作共有的语义，只跨步骤保留有助于区分动作的证据。Jev 再根据这些表示，对当前可选动作直接做结构化概率判断。在 R2R-CE 上，导航成功率 SR 为 27.0%，兼顾路径效率的成功指标 SPL 为 22.4%，每步 0.65 秒。作者报告，相比依赖多模态大模型的导航方法，推理延迟和费用明显下降。项目页：https://kai-sheng-caesar.github.io/NavJev/ 。
records.limitations_zh: Jev 处理的是视觉压缩后的候选动作表示，不是新训练的原生视觉 Jev；摘要仅提供 R2R-CE 结果，没有给延迟或费用下降的具体百分比。

records.title: The Argument and the Letterhead: Source-Position Coherence in AI Evaluation
records.abstract_original: An argument can be surprising coming from a particular speaker without being a bad argument. Do AI evaluators keep these judgments apart? Two preregistered descriptive studies and a later Jev supplement collected 2,976 usable evaluations of six fixed texts about US AI policy, Germany's debt brake and Swiss nuclear energy. Each text was presented under several source attributions. The key comparison asks whether the gap between two sources changes when the argument changes. On Sol, for example, a national-security argument received mean ratings of 0.359 under CODEPINK and 0.639 under College Republicans; a civil-rights argument received 0.742 and 0.721. A constant preference for one source cannot explain that pattern. Related interactions appeared across topics and recent model configurations, including those with reasoning enabled, while several comparisons yielded small effects. The later European Jev supplement yielded five interactions below the adopted absolute reference of 0.05; its distinct rubric and interrupted collection limit comparison with the chat systems. Some written evaluations explicitly invoked a mismatch between a source and its attributed position. Taken together, the numerical and verbal evidence supports source-position coherence as a plausible explanation, alongside competing accounts involving credibility, authenticity and interpretation of the task. The paper develops this inference through controlled comparisons, reports conditional post hoc p-values in an appendix, and documents the human decisions and delegated checks behind an AI-conducted study.
records.comment: 28 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Preregistrations, materials and code available on GitHub. Preprint; not yet peer reviewed
records.relationship_zh: 评估偏差；Jev 附加实验
records.one_sentence_zh: 固定论证换署名；Jev 补充结果效应较小，不能宣称无偏。
records.abstract_plain_zh: 某个观点不像某个组织会说的话，不等于观点本身差。作者检验AI会不会混淆二者：把六段固定政治政策论述署上不同来源，两个预注册描述性研究及后续Jev补充共得到2976次有效评分。Sol对同一国家安全论证的评分，署名CODEPINK为0.359、署名College Republicans为0.639；但公民权利论证中两者为0.742和0.721，因此不是简单偏爱某一来源。类似互动出现在不同主题和模型配置中，但部分效应较小。Jev欧洲补充的五项互动均低于预设绝对参照0.05。总体证据提示模型可能把“来源与观点是否搭配”混入论证评价，但来源可信度、真实性、任务理解等解释尚不能排除。
records.limitations_zh: Jev独立评分标准、分数集中、中断后恢复采集、服务时间/路由不同；小效应不证明无偏或比LLM更优。Jev版本1.13.0是依据文档推定，不是每次响应验证的固定快照。政治内容/来源是实验变量，不是给真实用户做政治影响；也不是投毒/后门。

records.title: Decide, Don't Generate: Competitive Dimensional ABSA with Jev's Typed Decisions
records.abstract_original: Aspect-based sentiment analysis (ABSA) has largely turned to text generation. We show that competitive dimensional ABSA does not need it. Using Jev, a frozen model that answers typed questions with rubric scores, label probabilities, and yes/no judgments, we decompose all three tasks of SemEval-2026 Task III Track A into such decisions and align them with the annotation scheme through 488 coefficients fitted on CPU, with no text generation and no backbone tuning. On valence-arousal regression over ten corpora in six languages, the system reaches 1.0645 RMSE, the lowest aggregate error of any participating system. On triplet and quadruplet extraction, it reaches 52.09 and 44.06 continuous F1, above fine-tuned Llama-3.3-70B and GPT-OSS-120B baselines. Analyses and ablations show where the accuracy comes from: supervised calibration roughly halves the raw regression error, exact valence-arousal would add only 4.5 F1 to extraction, and the learned combination of span-boundary evidence, not any single signal, carries the extraction systems.
records.one_sentence_zh: 冻结 Jev，加监督校准与片段证据组合完成回归和提取。
records.abstract_plain_zh: 方面级情感分析 ABSA 常用文本生成，本文尝试用决策输出完成同样任务。研究把 SemEval-2026 Task III Track A 的三个任务都拆成 Jev 可以回答的评分、标签概率和是非问题；冻结模型主体，不生成文字、不微调底座，只在 CPU 上拟合 488 个系数，使输出对齐任务标注规则。在六种语言、十个语料的情绪效价—唤醒度回归任务上，RMSE 为 1.0645，作者报告这是参评系统中的最低综合误差；三元组、四元组提取的连续 F1 分别为 52.09 和 44.06，超过微调后的 Llama-3.3-70B 与 GPT-OSS-120B 基线。消融表明，监督校准约将原始回归误差减半；即使情绪效价—唤醒度完全正确，提取任务也只会再增 4.5 F1。提取能力主要来自多个片段边界证据的学习组合，而非某一单独信号。
records.limitations_zh: 没有微调 Jev 底座不等于全程零样本：488 个系数使用监督拟合，性能相当依赖这一步校准与证据组合。

records.title: Jev thinks "I don't know'', but doesn't say it: Introducing Sys1Cal-v1 Dataset for Probability Calibration
records.abstract_original:
The appearance of Jev marked the era of System One Models, foundation models that return structured decisions with probability distributions rather than text. Aside from low cost and great speed, Jev's central promise is that these probabilities are calibrated: such claim is not backed by any public test and available external benchmarks evaluate confidence calibration, not whether every returned option probability has the right numerical meaning. To tackle this issue, we introduce Sys1Cal-v1, a dataset of True/False questions about a proposition $A$ for which the exact probability $P(A)$ is known by construction. Each item is queried through the three Jev primitives - Noul, Choice and Score - and evaluated by total variation distance from the ground-truth distribution, which can be used to estimate a soft accuracy of System One Models.
  We showcase the utility of Sys1Cal-v1 as a benchmark dataset by evaluating Jev and SemIf, an open-source Choice-style baseline. In this work, however, we focus even more deeply on Jev, by studying the calibration of its Score and Choice answers. In particular, we discover a peculiar behaviour that can be explained by assuming that Jev suppresses a third truth value, going beyond True and False. In other words, in 	exttt{Choice} answers, $P(A)$ and $P(
eg A)$ are presented as if $P(A)+P(
eg A)=1$, while a term $P(U)
eq0$ is missing in the sum. Recovering $P(U)$ leads to an improvement of median soft accuracy in 	exttt{Choice} answers from $0.771$ to $0.978$, suggesting that, even in binary decisions, Jev wants to answer with a third option:``I don't know''.
records.one_sentence_zh: 检查选项概率与未知状态；摘要提升数字涉及评分口径变化。
records.abstract_plain_zh: Jev的卖点不只是快，而是返回可信概率。作者认为既有评估主要检查最高分答案的置信度，没有直接检查每个选项的概率数值。于是构造Sys1Cal-v1：每道真假题的真实概率预先可精确计算，分别用Noul、Choice、Score提问，再衡量输出分布离真值有多远。他们比较Jev和开源SemIf，并重点分析Jev。Choice出现一种失真，可以用“真、假之外还有未表露的不确定状态”解释。摘要称恢复这种不确定性后，中位软准确度从0.771到0.978，提示强迫二选一可能丢失“不知道”的信息。
records.limitations_zh:
全文明确，0.978来自真/未知/假概率区间的兼容分数，而0.771是二元点概率分数，口径不完全可比；区间平均宽度0.292。相同二元口径的后校准中位数实际为0.903。因此不能写“准确率从77.1%提高到97.8%”。§7还把区间中位数写作0.971，与摘要/表3的0.978不一致，可保留表3值并说明是作者报告。

合成、模板化概率题；非现实安全benchmark。隐藏第三状态是观测性解释，不证明内部真有该变量，也不是证明模型具有主观“不知道”。没有训练投毒/后门。
